name: visualizations
tagline: One premium visual system for every agent
description: Visualizer Studio replaces the old theme pack with one unified visual system for AI agents. It keeps the legacy classics, adds advanced cinematic renderers like Black Sun, Tropical Iris, Cathedral of Minds, Cipher Mesh, Prism, Triage Lanes, Commander Sigil, Annotation Lens, Browser Lens, and Momentum Board, and gives each visualizer its own proper control surface inside a single studio workflow.
shortDescription: Unified premium visual system with legacy classics and advanced renderers
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Unified visualizer library: legacy classics plus Black Sun, Tropical Iris, Cathedral of Minds, Cipher Mesh, Prism, Triage Lanes, Commander Sigil, Annotation Lens, Browser Lens, Momentum Board, HUD-Q, Signal Bloom, Living Ink, and more
Audio-reactive motion and state-driven behavior across every agent
One studio workflow for assignment, presets, preview states, and tuning
Native controls for advanced renderers, with legacy controls preserved in the same product
Popout window mode for dedicated visualizer display

studioLibrary.name: Unified Visualizer Library
studioLibrary.description: Legacy visualizers and advanced cinematic renderers live in one product: Eye-Q, Nexus, Iris, Black Sun, Tropical Iris, Cathedral of Minds, Cipher Mesh, Prism, Triage Lanes, Commander Sigil, Annotation Lens, Browser Lens, Momentum Board, HUD-Q, Orbital Cathedral, Signal Bloom, Mind Swarm, Living Ink, Gaia Eye, and more.

audioReactivity.name: Audio-Reactive Animation
audioReactivity.description: Visualizers respond to real-time audio data. Speech, listening, thinking, and error states drive motion, intensity, gaze, bloom, and behavior.

studioWorkflow.name: Studio Workflow
studioWorkflow.description: Pick a renderer, switch preview states, test presets, and tune settings from one editor without splitting between old and new systems.

perAgentAssignment.name: Per-Agent Assignment
perAgentAssignment.description: Assign a different visualizer to each agent. Keep defaults, reuse flagship presets, or give every assistant its own identity.

perStateConfig.name: Renderer-Specific Controls
perStateConfig.description: Advanced renderers get native controls for motion, bloom, gaze, palette, and intensity. Legacy renderers retain their original speed, scale, sensitivity, and hue tuning.

popoutMode.name: Popout Window
popoutMode.description: Open any visualiser in a dedicated popup window for presentations, streaming overlays, or ambient display.

settingsExport.name: Settings Export/Import
settingsExport.description: Back up and restore your visualiser configurations. Transfer settings between instances.
